status: Frozen before new spectroscopy matching or outcomes; previous SED age/brightness results already seen.
primary_samples: all available ZTF host positions and TITAN exact transient aliases
original G11 host coordinates with C25 ages
DustPedia/Cepheid hosts where sky coordinates available

crossmatch.diagnostics: Retain all nearby candidates, ambiguous matches and redshift failures. Spectral fibre target is central host, not automatically SN site.

catalogues: MPA-JHU DR7 direct Dn4000 and Balmer/emission line measurements
MaNGA DR17 FIREFLY global stellar population summaries (MILES and MaStar)
MaNGA spectra/local cells when host overlap supports meaningful aperture comparison
primary_tests: Spearman age-versus-Dn4000 and Hdelta on independent spectra
conditional age diagnostics after mass/redshift controls
same physical SN brightness model with spectral diagnostics added, host-group holdouts if sample permits
central-versus-global/local aperture effects and disagreement across stellar library models
scope: Independent observing modality, not independent stellar physics or model-free age. Catalogue duplicates do not count as independent galaxies. Avoid complete-catalogue claims or treating posteriors as likelihoods.
